args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and extra batteries/memory cards

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach Day (Waikiki Beach - June 11):
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (or plan to rent)

Snorkeling (Hanauma Bay - June 12):
- Rash guard/swim shirt
- Water shoes
- Underwater camera (optional)

Hiking (Diamond Head - June 13):
- Sturdy hiking shoes
- Hiking socks
- Lightweight, moisture-wicking clothes
- Small backpack
- Water bottle
- Trail snacks

Pearl Harbor Visit (June 14):
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Respectful attire (covered shoulders and knees recommended)

North Shore Road Trip (June 15):
- Car essentials (if renting)
- Cooler for drinks/snacks
- Extra layers for changing weather

Luau Experience (June 16):
- Hawaiian shirt or aloha attire (optional but fun)
- Comfortable clothes for sitting on the ground

Spa Day (June 17):
- Spa-appropriate swimwear
- Flip-flops

Kayaking (Kailua Beach - June 18):
- Quick-dry clothing
- Water shoes
- Waterproof bag for valuables

Shopping (Ala Moana Center - June 19):
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Reusable shopping bags

Health & Safety:
- Sunscreen (reef-safe recommended in Hawaii)
- Aloe vera gel for sunburns
- Basic first aid kit
- Prescription medications
- Insect repellent
- Hand sanitizer

Electronics:
- Universal power adapter (if needed)
- Portable power bank
- Waterproof case for electronics

Miscellaneous:
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for day trips
- Books or e-reader for relaxation
- Travel pillow for flights
- Small umbrella or rain jacket (for unexpected showers)
